data.long_meaning: In Hebrew, Jeremiah means 'God will uplift', 'God sets up'. The name is derived from the Hebrew word yarah which means to 'throw' and the word yamim which means 'days'. The name Jeremya carries the meaning “God will uplift” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. in_hebrew.long_meaning: ירמיהו הוא שם עברי שמשמעותו 'ה' יקים' או 'שופט ה''. השם מורכב משתי מילים: 'ירם' שפירושו 'ה' יקים' ו'יה' שפירושו 'ה'' או 'אלוהים'. השם היה נפוץ בקרב היהודים בתקופת המקרא, והוא שם של אחד הנביאים החשובים ביותר ביהדות, הנביא ירמיהו.

in_greek.name: Ιερεμίας
in_greek.meaning: ο Θεός θεμελιώνει ή κρίνον του Θεού
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Ιερεμίας προέρχεται από το εβραϊκό όνομα ירמיהו, που σημαίνει 'ο Θεός θεμελιώνει' ή 'κρίνον του Θεού'. Το όνομα ήταν κοινό μεταξύ των Εβραίων κατά την περίοδο της Αγίας Γραφής και είναι το όνομα ενός από τους πιο σημαντικούς προφήτες στην Ιουδαϊκή παράδοση, τον προφήτη Ιερεμία.

in_latin.name: Jeremya
in_latin.meaning: The Lord establishes or Appointed by God
in_latin.long_meaning: The name Jeremya is derived from the Hebrew name ירמיהו, which means 'The Lord establishes' or 'Appointed by God'. This name was prevalent among Jews during the Biblical era and is the name of one of the most significant prophets in Judaism, the prophet Jeremiah. The name has been adopted into various Christian traditions, symbolizing divine appointment and spiritual leadership.

in_english.name: Jeremya

in_english.long_meaning: The name Jeremya originates from the Hebrew name ירמיהו (Yirmeyahu), meaning 'exalted by God' or 'appointed by the Lord'. It is derived from the roots 'yrm' (to throw or cast) and 'yhw' (God). In the Bible, Jeremiah was a major prophet who played a crucial role in the spiritual revival of Judah. The name Jeremya symbolizes a person who is chosen and established by God for a higher purpose. Throughout Christian tradition, the name has been associated with prophetic leadership, divine guidance, and spiritual devotion.

data.cultural_impact: The name Jeremiah was popular among the ancient Hebrews, and it is still used among Christian communities today. Jeremiah is known for being one of the most prominent prophets in the Old Testament, who delivered God's message to the Israelites during a time of great turmoil and destruction. His prophecies include warnings of impending doom due to the Israelites' disobedience to God, as well as promises of a new covenant and restoration. Jeremiah's legacy continues to inspire and influence Jewish and Christian communities through his writings, which are deeply rooted in the Hebrew tradition and culture.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Jeremiah holds significant spiritual meaning for those who bear it, as it is a reminder that God is always present and active in our lives, even during the most challenging times. The name symbolizes the idea that God will uplift and support us, and that He has the power to set things right, even when it may not seem that way. For Christians, Jeremiah's legacy as a prophet who delivered God's message feels deeply personal, as it resonates with the broader biblical theme of God's love, care, and guidance for His people. Ultimately, the spiritual significance of the name Jeremiah is a source of comfort and inspiration, reminding us that no matter what challenges we may face, God is always with us and will never leave us alone.
